title: Audited Precursor SA Evaluation: Un-Hardcoded Continuous Physical Screening & ML Cross-Validation

phase2_metadata.framework: SevenNet (7net-0 LBFGS Relaxed) + Cavallo SambVca Sphere
phase2_metadata.relaxation_method: ASE LBFGS (Monomer fmax=0.04 eV/A, <=100 steps; Dimer fmax=0.04 eV/A, <=35 steps)
phase2_metadata.dimer_shift_rule: z_shift = z_span + 2.8 A along thinnest principal axis (non-overlapping gap >= 2.8 A)
phase2_metadata.bde_method: Relaxed separated fragment dissociation E(ML_{n-1})+E(L)-E(ML_n) for acyclic bonds; FixAtoms exocyclic-shifted stretch for cyclic bonds
pillars: 4. Monomer vs Dimerization Interaction (Delta E_dimer, kcal/mol)

analytical_comparison.methodology: Uniform continuous C-infinity TMC-SA_phys (ligand_sa + smooth E_coh/BDE/Vbur/dE_dimer penalties <= 4.0); zero target_type branching or hardcoded IDs.

machine_learning_comparison.note: Evaluated using genuine computed Phase 1 (fixed BR-SAScore + real ligand_sa) and latest Phase 2 (SevenNet-0 + SambVca without algebraic complexation proxy) features. In-sample Gini importances are reported alongside strict out-of-fold 5-Fold CV and LOOCV metrics.
